attempts.summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as a shared writable directory with the sticky bit (mode 1777, owner root:root). Verified any user can write files but only the file owner (or root) can delete them. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, restarted node1 with `shutdown -r now`, confirmed boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and re-verified the directory permissions and delete-protection behavior post-restart with fresh test users.
